description: Generate 2 square (1024×1024) fictional character portraits from a text description in one of 8 art styles. Costs 4 credits (Standard) or 6 credits (HD for accounts that have purchased a pack). Enqueues asynchronously and returns jobId immediately — call get_job after ~5–10 seconds to get the 2 assetIds and signed image URLs. Requires Authorization: Bearer avs_...

prompt.description: Visual description of an original fictional character (3–500 chars), e.g. "weathered dwarven blacksmith with copper braids and glowing forge goggles". Avoid real people, celebrities, or explicit content.

style.description: Art style preset ID: anime, 3d-cartoon, pixel-art, realistic, professional-headshot, fantasy, watercolor, cyberpunk.

name: generate_avatars
title: Generate Fictional Character Avatars
